title: In dec_vlc_read of oapv_vlc.c, there is a possible out-of-bounds read due to a heap buffer overflow. (CVE-2026-58953)
description: A heap buffer overflow in the dec_vlc_read function of oapv_vlc.c can cause an out-of-bounds read. This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to disclose information without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
